name: Palazzo Versace Gold Coast
description: The most glamorous hotel on the Gold Coast — Palazzo Versace is a magnificent 5-star Italian palazzo resort on the Broadwater in Hope Island, 25 minutes from Movie World. Designed in collaboration with the Versace fashion house with marble interiors, Versace-furnished rooms and suites, lagoon pools, a world-class spa and multiple award-winning restaurants. The ultimate luxury base for a Movie World visit.

rooms.description: Versace-furnished deluxe room with Broadwater or garden views, marble bathroom and premium amenities.

rooms.name: Versace Suite
rooms.description: Lavish suite with separate living area, full Versace furnishings and panoramic Broadwater views.

rooms.name: Lagoon Room
rooms.description: Elegant room with direct lagoon pool access and Versace bathroom amenities.

name: JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort and Spa
description: A magnificent 5-star beachfront resort in Surfers Paradise, 20 minutes from Movie World — JW Marriott Gold Coast offers stunning Pacific Ocean views, multiple outdoor pools, a full-service spa, award-winning dining and the acclaimed Niwa Japanese restaurant. One of the finest luxury hotel experiences on the Gold Coast.

rooms.name: Ocean View Room
rooms.description: Spacious room with stunning Pacific Ocean views, king bed and marble bathroom.

rooms.name: Ocean Suite
rooms.description: Generous suite with panoramic ocean views, separate living area and premium spa bathroom.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Elegant deluxe room with resort or city views and premium JW Marriott amenities.

name: InterContinental Sanctuary Cove Resort
description: A prestigious 5-star resort set within the exclusive Sanctuary Cove gated community, 15 minutes from Movie World. Features two championship golf courses, multiple pools, a full spa, tennis courts and waterfront dining in one of Queensland most beautiful resort settings.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with separate living area, garden views and complimentary breakfast.

name: Mantra at Sharks
description: A well-appointed 4-star hotel in Broadbeach, 15 minutes from Movie World — Mantra at Sharks offers comfortable rooms, an outdoor pool, gymnasium and easy access to Broadbeach dining and entertainment precinct. Excellent value for families visiting the Gold Coast theme parks.
